name: StayBehind
description: Make follower(s) step in behind the player.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for members of your Nether's Follower Framework party. One follower steps right behind you; a group closes ranks at near follow distance instead.
prompt: If the player tells you to get behind them or stay behind them, begin your response with '{key}:'
